text.en: Reloading after a kill loads magazine with a few extra-damage bullets. Grants radar while aiming down sights.

Counts as a "Dealer's Choice" origin trait weapon, but does not benefit from the trait itself.

Grants Radar while Aiming Down Sights.

Finishing a reload within 3.6 seconds of a kill grants 6 'Memento Mori' shots, each dealing <pve 68% /> <pvp [29%] /> increased damage.

Stowing the weapon removes the buff.
